Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 21

“With the self unattached to outward contacts, one finds the happiness that is in the self. With the self joined to the yoga of Brahman, one enjoys imperishable happiness.”

Krishna is careful to promise happiness, not its absence. The argument is about sourcing — an inner supply that cannot run out, rather than an outer one that must.
